title: Changing one customer's term leaves no note and no log row
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You change one Net 30 customer's term to Net 45 in Edit Customer.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Customer {Customer-A} holds Net 30.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S11-18 Customer.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
  2. Choose "Net 45" in Credit Terms.
  3. Click Save.
  4. Click the "Notes" tab.
  5. Open the Credit Terms page.
  6. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  7. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window opens.
  • Step 2: the dropdown shows Net 45.
  • Step 3: the window closes and the customer is saved on Net 45.
  • Step 4: no new note about the credit term was written (only Move Customers writes one).
  • Step 5: the page opens.
  • Step 6: the menu opens.
  • Step 7: no row was written for this change.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • Out of Scope: “A change history for single customers and vendors. A term or credit limit changed one record at a time (New or Edit Customer, Edit Vendor, imports, the Public API) leaves no visible record, exactly as today; only Move Customers writes a note on each moved customer (S4-R11) and a Credit Terms Log row. A customer and vendor audit log is a later Founder Mode item.”
  • S12-N3: “Changes made outside the Credit Terms page (a customer's or vendor's term or credit limit changed in New Customer, Edit Customer, Edit Vendor, by import or by the Public API) are not in this log.”
